verdict.rationale: Discord's own blog documents Threads, including Private Threads, as a way to branch a conversation off a channel's main feed. That is optional branching, though: conversations do not have to live under a named topic, so the main feed stays a mixed stream. Community feedback notes channels get very chaotic when many people post. missing for 10: conversations required to sit under a named topic/thread, catch-up tooling (unread thread summaries, inbox), in-depth docs on thread naming and organization, independent hands-on corroboration that threads make busy channels easier to catch up on.
